claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b085] Scope decisions for this file, which covers the whole of results/README.md (lines 1-300; the document is 300 lines long). Out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5 and therefore not extracted: dates (2026-05-26, 2026-04-08, the 'May 2026' currency stamp at line 247); preregistration version strings (v2.0, v2.9); hypothesis identifiers (H1, H3, H4, H5, H7, H8, H9, H10, H11, H12); phase identifiers (Phases 2a-2e, Phase 2c, Phase 3a, 3b, 3c, 3d, and 'Phase 3' of the audit plan); Obs 322; 'Stage Gate 1'; the Era 1 / Era 2 shorthand; and every number inside a directory or file name (`phase3a-image-matrix/`, `h11-384-pv-diagnostic/`, `h11-384-single-pass-t0-rerun/`, `h8-v2/`, `h10/`, `h12-v2/`, `e47-propose-brief/`, `gs-125m-fp-side-6-crop-review/`, `gt-duplicate-review-gs4/`, `-era2`, `55maps-*`, `phase2*`, `phase3d-*`, `strand1-verbosity`, `strand2-h5-confirm`, `h6-flash-pro`). The changelog row at line 276 carries only version strings and strand names and so yields no claim at all. Corpus sizes are extracted where the prose asserts them ('the 4-map gold-standard sub-corpus' at line 84, 'the full 4-map tileset' at line 95, 'the full 55-map corpus' at line 125) but not where '55-map' merely labels a heading, a directory, or a group of directories (lines 122, 129-145, 175, and the 'After' cell of line 275). Anchor note: several counts here enumerate the working tree rather than reading a scalar out of a JSON artefact (sub-directories under results/, top-level .md files, Python scripts under scripts/, threshold_sweep_summary.md files under results/h11-384-pv-diagnostic/); those are recorded as method recompute-script with the directory itself named as anchor.file, since no committed artefact holds the scalar. Tile-pool counts anchor to the tracked manifests under inputs/tiles/ (calibration_manifest.json, validation_manifest.json), which are JSON arrays of tile filenames and so are counted with the len: prefix.
